observations: A large face fills most of the frame with two mismatched eye zones: the left rendered as a dark inward spiral, the right as a wide oval containing a small drawn eye, both banded by zigzag lines across the brow.

The background is saturated yellow-gold, broken by vertical dark-green stripes on the right, blue cloud shapes upper-left, and stacked red-and-blue zigzag blocks lower-left that form dense patterned panels.
Loose looping lines in red, blue, and white run across the face and neck over flat fills of pink, teal, and orange; a row of white teeth is visible at the open mouth near lower center.
reading: Two eyes built from completely different marks anchor a face assembled from flat color and restless looping lines. The spiral left eye and the outlined right eye pull attention in opposite directions, giving the face an off-balance, watchful quality. Dense zigzag panels crowd the lower-left corner, echoing the brow bands and placing the face inside the same mark-making energy that constructs it.
